findings.details: android-17.0.0_r1 ThreadPoolExecutor.java 明确要求 allowCoreThreadTimeOut(true) 的 keepAliveTime 大于零；AbortPolicy 的拒绝也来自 shutdown；CallerRunsPolicy 在 shutdown 后静默丢弃。正文把拒绝等同满载并无条件描述 caller-run，可能误导生命周期处理。
findings.summary: 线程池超时与拒绝策略遗漏关闭状态和有效参数边界

findings.close_note: 按 Android 17 r1 AMS 明确 setProcState >= HOME、CPU 增量 / uptimeMillis 增量 * 100，以及 uptime 排除深度睡眠、不可与 elapsedRealtime 百分比直接混用；附 SystemClock 官方入口。
findings.details: ActivityManagerService.java 16064-16085 与 16191-16192 用 uptimeMillis 增量作分母，排除深度睡眠；正文只称窗口墙钟，易与前文计入深度睡眠的 elapsedRealtime 样本混用。受检条件是 setProcState >= PROCESS_STATE_HOME，不能把全部受检对象概括为缓存进程。
findings.summary: CPU 使用过量检查遗漏 uptime 分母与受检进程状态边界

findings.close_note: Replaced linear state sequence with Sink/Source Disable and Receiver Stop Ready branches; retained release/configuration-cache boundary. Confirmed against ASCS 1.0.1 and tagged state_machine.cc; metadata, SUMMARY and diff gates pass.
findings.details: ASCS 1.0.1 sections 5.5 and 5.6: Sink Disable returns to QoS Configured; Source enters Disabling until Receiver Stop Ready. AOSP android-17.0.0_r1 state_machine.cc lines 3511-3517 rejects Sink Disabling. Localized safe correction.
findings.summary: ASE stop states incorrectly presented as a single mandatory sequence

findings.close_note: Replaced duplicated receiver-cost formula with BAP source-processing + Transport_Latency + Presentation_Delay model; corrected route-switch and stream-start prose consistently. BAP section 7 verified and local gates pass.
findings.details: BAP 1.0 sections 7.1 and 7.2 include sink codec, internal transport, ADC/DAC and audio processing inside Presentation_Delay. Total delay is source processing plus Transport_Latency plus Presentation_Delay. Remove duplicated receiver decoding/rendering term.
findings.summary: Latency budget double-counts receiver processing after Presentation Delay

findings.close_note: Split diagram into software HCI and vendor offload media paths with separate control edges. Added HCI capture limits, full-log/restart requirement and Controller/radio evidence boundary. Mermaid renders successfully; local gates pass.
findings.details: SessionType offload sessions are control-only. codec_manager.cc lines 115-133 and 188-192 distinguish platform ISO and HCI paths. HCI snoop records Host/Controller interface packets, not every radio retransmission, and may omit offload ISO payload. Official debugging instructions require restarting Bluetooth after enabling full snoop.
findings.summary: Serial diagram and HCI guidance conflate offload media path with Host and radio capture

findings.close_note: Added property enablement and compatible HAL requirements, retaining legacy path when disabled/old. Preserved HFP/SCO scope; added API 37 setBluetoothScoOn deprecation/no-op and API 31 migration boundary from official reference. Local gates pass.
findings.details: Official Audio Managed SCO Backward compatibility and Requirements sections condition the new path on system property enablement and compatible AHAL/BT AHAL. Disabled property or old HAL can retain legacy path; Android version alone does not establish adoption.
findings.summary: Android 17 SCO rearchitecture omits property and compatible HAL requirements

findings.close_note: Replaced the conflated Criteria account with separate query/update semantics and documented API 34/API 31 deprecation; checked against pinned source and official API reference.
findings.details: Pinned LocationManager.java lines 1348-1360 and 1414-1420 route Criteria update requests directly to FUSED_PROVIDER. Official documentation says this behavior applies since KitKat and these overloads were deprecated at API 31. getBestProvider and getProviders(Criteria, boolean) were deprecated at API 34.
findings.summary: Criteria provider selection conflates getBestProvider with fixed-fused update overloads and omits deprecation levels

findings.close_note: Documented API 33 age-method availability and the API 31-32 same-boot nanosecond comparison. Official Location lifecycle notices were inspected.
findings.details: The official Location reference marks getElapsedRealtimeAgeMillis and getElapsedRealtimeMillis as added in API 33. API 31-32 callers must compare SystemClock.elapsedRealtimeNanos against Location.getElapsedRealtimeNanos in the same boot and clock domain.
findings.summary: Location age recommendation omits API 33 availability within the declared API 31-37 range

findings.close_note: Restricted merge semantics to non-passive requests, documented developer-setting input and hasIsFullTracking guard, and corrected the setter owner to Builder. Source and writing gates passed.
findings.details: GnssMeasurementsProvider.java lines 197-226 skips PASSIVE_INTERVAL registrations and separately honors the developer full-tracking setting. GnssMeasurementsEvent.isFullTracking is valid only when hasIsFullTracking is true. setFullTracking belongs to GnssMeasurementRequest.Builder, not GnssMeasurementRequest.
findings.summary: GNSS full-tracking section omits passive-request and optional-event-field boundaries and names the setter on the wrong class

findings.close_note: Separated Binder package ownership validation, request sanitization, and dynamic provider-manager allowlist matching. Removed the unsupported attributionTag/UID consistency assertion.
findings.details: LocationManagerService.registerLocationListener constructs CallerIdentity before validateLocationRequest. CallerIdentity.fromBinder validates package ownership but records attributionTag without the claimed UID-consistency check. Privileged bypass allowlists are checked in LocationProviderManager.calculateProviderLocationRequest, not validateLocationRequest.
findings.summary: validateLocationRequest is incorrectly credited with CallerIdentity package checks and provider-manager allowlist policy

findings.close_note: Prefetch launchState after super.onCreate and before registering the condition. The callback only reads launchState.value. Source-backed static regression and local gates passed.
findings.details: 4.1 示例把 viewModel.launchState.value 放进条件闭包，by viewModels() 的首次取值可能创建 ViewModel；与回调只读取已有内存状态及后文生产要求不一致。应在 super.onCreate 后、注册条件前取得 launchState 引用。
findings.summary: KeepOnScreenCondition 示例在首次绘制回调中首次访问惰性 ViewModel

findings.close_note: Replaced withEndAction-only removal with idempotent cleanup shared by animation end, cancellation and Activity destruction. Listeners are detached. Warning confirmed in Android 17 source and official API docs; static regression passed.
findings.details: ViewPropertyAnimator 官方文档及 android-17.0.0_r1 源码明确规定动画取消时 withEndAction 不执行。原示例不包含取消和 Activity 销毁清理，与本节清理要求不一致；需共享幂等移除函数并覆盖正常结束、取消和销毁。
findings.summary: 退出动画示例只在 withEndAction 中移除 Splash，取消路径会跳过清理

findings.close_note: Documented compileSdk >= 35, Android Gradle Plugin >= 8.6.0, and runtime minSdk 21 separately. Values verified in the downloaded Google Maven 1.2.0 AAR, not inferred from the older migration guide.
findings.details: Google Maven 1.2.0 AAR 的 aar-metadata.properties 声明 minCompileSdk=35、minAndroidGradlePluginVersion=8.6.0，而 AndroidManifest.xml 的 minSdkVersion=21。接入段仅给 implementation，需说明构建下限与运行系统下限的区别，避免照搬旧迁移页 compileSdk 31。
findings.summary: core-splashscreen 1.2.0 接入缺少 AAR 声明的构建工具下限

findings.close_note: Replaced RSS-plus-swap statement with same-adj RSS plus readable DMA-BUF PSS; pinned source and local gates checked.
findings.details: lmkd.cpp lines 1073-1097 read statm RSS; lines 2294-2326 add dmabuf_pss; lines 2602-2634 traverse adj buckets in descending order.
findings.summary: Android 17 heaviest-task selection uses RSS plus available DMA-BUF PSS within one adj, not RSS plus swap

findings.close_note: Diagram, sequence, request conditions, comparison table and trace steps now agree on unfreeze before asynchronous prefetch; Mermaid rendered successfully.
findings.details: CachedAppOptimizer.java lines 1526-1536 unfreeze before requesting prefetch; lines 3043-3084 gate on Activity reason and feature support. MMD service.rs lines 300-307 enqueue work and return.
findings.summary: Prefetch diagram and sequence incorrectly place application execution after asynchronous prefetch completion

findings.close_note: Clarified intra-page same-word detection and zsmalloc pool-only memory accounting against pinned kernel source.
findings.details: zram_drv.c lines 331-350 compare words within one page; lines 2181-2213 report zsmalloc pool pages; lines 2249-2262 allocate the slot table separately.
findings.summary: same_pages requires identical words within one page; mem_used_total excludes separately allocated ZRAM structures

findings.close_note: Added last-sample semantics, kB units, zero-before-sample case and API 30 boundary from official reference.
findings.details: Official getPss and getRss reference: API 30, values in kB, last sampling only, zero if the process dies before being sampled.
findings.summary: ApplicationExitInfo PSS and RSS are last samples, not snapshots around death, and can be zero before any sample

findings.close_note: 重写原生内存统计说明，补齐 malloc 与显式登记两部分，以及 NotifyNativeAllocations、RegisterNativeAllocation 和 CheckGCForNative 的检查边界；开篇同步采用 ART 统计到的原生压力口径。
findings.details: android-17.0.0_r1 heap.cc:2802-2839 的 GetNativeBytes() 返回 mallinfo().uordblks 与 native_bytes_registered_ 之和；4579-4636 的检查入口使用此总量。原文排除了未逐笔登记的 malloc 分配，会误导 native SDK 压力排查。
findings.summary: 原生 GC 压力统计被误写为只包含显式登记内存

findings.close_note: 在分配录制与发布耗时隔离说明之后补入 Android 8/API26+ 的 native 工具开销警告，保留 debuggable、Full/Sampled 和只用于归因等现有条件。
findings.details: 当前 record-java-kotlin-allocations HTML 的 How memory is counted 节含 Note：Android 8/API26+ 会把部分 profiling tools 内存误计入 App native memory。opencli Markdown 提取遗漏 aside；原始 HTML 已复核。正文需要提示该偏差，避免把录制开销归因于应用。
findings.summary: 分配记录遗漏 Android 8 起分析工具计入 native 内存的官方警告

findings.close_note: 补充 Perfetto UI 官方录制流程要求 Android 11/API30+，本章覆盖的 Android 8—10 使用 record_android_trace 等命令行流程。
findings.details: 当前 Recording system traces 文档将 Perfetto UI 录制前置条件列为 Android R+，更早版本使用 Android 命令行流程；record_android_trace 文档前置条件为 Android M+。原文只提查看 atrace 类别，缺少不同录制入口的版本边界。
findings.summary: Android 8—17 章节未交代 Perfetto UI 录制的 Android 11 起适用边界

findings.close_note: Clarified getTotalPss includes SwapPss, no double addition, Code JIT caches and private Graphics. Source Debug.java 425-426 and 734-923; metadata, summary links, diff and prose gates passed.
findings.details: r1 Debug.MemoryInfo.getTotalPss adds getTotalSwappedOutPss. Distinguish resident smaps Pss from App Summary TOTAL PSS and TOTAL SWAP PSS. Also clarify JIT code caches and private graphics categories.
findings.summary: App Summary TOTAL PSS includes SwapPss: prevent double counting

findings.close_note: Corrected Limiter.updateIsReady locator, manual MiB and none no-reset warning, swap flag condition, status templates and limits/monitoring/killing. Checked shell-to-Java-to-JNI flow and source-derived sentinel arithmetic. No device test claimed.
findings.details: Shell none becomes -1, Java multiplies by MiB, JNI skips node writes for values at or below -2. The four status memory values are configured visibility templates, not actual PID node values; inspect limits, monitoring, killing. updateIsReady belongs to Limiter, not ProcessMemInfo. JNI writes memory.swap.max despite stale Java swap.high comments.
findings.summary: MemoryLimiter manual none does not reliably reset limits in r1; status shows templates

findings.close_note: Preserved API 37 shared-UID multi-package artifact delivery caveat in the anomaly bullet, checked against r1 ProfilingTrigger.java 103-115 and official API reference. Existing OOM default-handler and API 35/36/37 boundaries retained.
findings.details: r1 ProfilingTrigger.java lines 110-112 and the API 37 reference warn that for some anomalies artifacts may not be provided when multiple packages sharing a UID register this trigger.
findings.summary: ProfilingTrigger ANOMALY omits the shared-UID multi-package delivery warning

findings.close_note: Added per-reboot kill limit, history.json and denied SELinux domain failure. Verified official PMGD System health features and SELinux configuration; no universal enablement claimed.
findings.details: Official System health features restrict each target to one PMGD-initiated kill per device reboot, with history in /data/misc/pmgd/history.json. SELinux must allow the target domain or PMGD cannot monitor it.
findings.summary: PMGD omits per-reboot kill rate limiting and denied-domain monitoring failure

ART runtime/GC absence of MADV_COLD and r6 whole-tree absence of ANON_VMA_LAZY require directory-wide evidence, not a defconfig or selected-file sample. Keep ready-for-review. findings.details: 多进程场景把不可信插件与限制访问权限并列为普通分进程用途，却未说明 :remote 默认仍共享应用 UID/权限。需区分崩溃与地址空间隔离、isolatedProcess 服务权限隔离，并保留系统组件限制。

findings.close_note: 改为 Android 14 起经 CTS 测试的公开 API，补互斥注解、CriticalNative ABI、GC 挂起限制、8–11 显式注册、12 起动态查找及旧设备 ABI 风险。依据官方 JNI tips。 结构化来源证据 claim_id=jni-annotations。
findings.details: 官方 JNI tips 说明 Android 14 起为经 CTS 测试的公开 API。原段缺失 CriticalNative ABI、GC 阻塞、Android 8-11 显式注册等适用条件。
findings.summary: FastNative 与 CriticalNative 被错误限定为系统级场景

findings.close_note: 把 fork 瞬间与 ActivityThread.main 之前分开，明确 nativeZygoteInit/onZygoteInit 在 Java 入口前启动 Binder 池。固定 Android 17 标签重新下载核对。 结构化来源证据 claim_id=binder-before-main。
findings.details: 进程章节泛称刚启动时只有主线程，前文却确认 zygoteInit/nativeZygoteInit 先启动 Binder 线程池。需明确 fork 瞬间与 ActivityThread.main 之前两个时点，避免按单线程进程排障。
findings.summary: 应用进程进入业务入口仍只有主线程的描述与 Binder 初始化顺序冲突

findings.close_note: 补普通 Worker 10 分钟限制、长任务仍走 JobScheduler、Android 16 作业配额、target34 服务类型及旧版本位置/相机/麦克风要求。依据官方 Worker 与长任务文档。 结构化来源证据 claim_id=background-apis。
findings.details: 原建议从普通 Worker 时长限制直接转到长任务/前台服务规则，未交代长任务仍依赖 JobScheduler、Android 16 起可能耗尽 quota，以及 target API34+ 的前台服务类型要求。
findings.summary: WorkManager 长任务建议缺失 Android 14 服务类型与 Android 16 作业配额边界

findings.close_note: 分别解释工厂 API 发布开关、未带同一 FlaggedApi 的 isVirtual、ART continuation 开关及 BoundVirtualThread 回退；同步修正版本表，未承诺所有构建轻量线程复用。 结构化来源证据 claim_id=virtual-api-runtime。
findings.details: libcore current.txt 中 isVirtual 无 FlaggedApi，工厂接口受 virtual_thread_api_v1 控制；ContinuationSupport 则依赖 ART virtualThreadImplV1，ThreadBuilders 在不支持 continuation 时可返回 BoundVirtualThread。API 存在不能保证轻量线程实现。
findings.summary: 虚拟线程 API 公开开关与运行时实现支持混为一层

findings.close_note: 补 HIDL 自 Android 13 废弃但兼容存量、Stable AIDL 的 VINTF 声明与冻结要求、vendor NDK 后端、libbinder 分区限制和 Java 后端警告。 结构化来源证据 claim_id=hal-vintf。
findings.details: HAL 官方总览明确 Android 13 起废弃 HIDL、仍支持既有实现；AIDL HAL 指南警告 vendor 原生代码不能直接依赖不稳定 libbinder C++ 接口，需使用 NDK 后端等稳定接口。需补到接口边界说明，避免 Stable AIDL 被理解为只加稳定性声明。
findings.summary: HAL 迁移说明缺少 HIDL 废弃版本与 vendor AIDL 后端限制

findings.close_note: 把 onReceive 返回即结束活跃限定为未用 goAsync 的普通路径；补 PendingResult.finish、整个异步区间的广播超时及非持久执行边界。 结构化来源证据 claim_id=receiver-lifecycle。
findings.details: BroadcastReceiver.goAsync 自 API11 起允许 onReceive 返回后维持广播活跃至 PendingResult.finish，仍受广播超时限制；原句无条件把返回视为失去保护。需区分普通回调与 goAsync，并禁止把延期解释为持久后台执行。
findings.summary: 广播回调返回即失去活跃状态的描述遗漏 goAsync 有限延期

findings.details: ACK android17-6.18-2026-06_r6 binder.c 的 BR_SPAWN_LOOPER 条件有 force_spawn 或默认判断两条入口，原文把默认判断当成全部条件。需明确默认路径与厂商钩子覆盖。
findings.summary: Binder 动态增线程条件遗漏 ACK force_spawn 厂商钩子

findings.details: Kotlin 协程与 ANR 现场把 runBlocking、withContext、Mutex、Deferred.await 并列为主线程卡住的位置，未区分调用线程阻塞与协程挂起，容易将正常挂起误判为 ANR 现场。官方 API 明确 await 不阻塞线程，Mutex.lock 等待时挂起；Android 文档建议用 withContext 将阻塞工作移到后台。

findings.close_note: 已删除将退出线程对象引用等同于存活原生线程的错误清单项；改为仍在运行的 HandlerThread/线程池工作线程，并区分 ThreadLocal 对象持有、Java detached pthread 栈回收和 native joinable 线程收尾。Android 17 固定标签下 thread.cc、pthread_exit.cpp、pthread_join.cpp、pthread_detach.cpp、ThreadLocal.java、ThreadPoolExecutor.java 与 HandlerThread.java 已核对；目标元数据、SUMMARY 链接及作用域 diff 检查通过。
findings.details: 原文将“线程退出后仍被 ThreadLocal、HandlerThread 或线程池引用”列作线程数量失控原因。固定 Android 17 标签中，ART 创建 Java 平台线程时使用 PTHREAD_CREATE_DETACHED；Bionic 对 detached 线程在退出时拆除自管栈映射。ThreadLocal 值的长期持有应与仍存活的工作线程关联，已终止 Thread 对象的 Java 引用不等于仍有活跃 TID 或原生栈。应直接替换错误列表项并说明对象、工作线程与 native joinable 线程的回收边界。
findings.summary: 线程数量失控清单把已退出线程对象被引用误写成原生线程资源未释放

findings.close_note: 已按 Android 17 IGraphicBufferProducer 与 Surface/BufferQueueProducer 源码分开槽所有权、复用 fence 和新写入 acquire fence；同步修正 Perfetto 诊断及对应检查表。没有将 dequeue slice 直接归因为 release fence，也未断言所有内部实现都不等待 fence。源码断言、中文门与本章 diff 检查通过。
findings.details: 公共主线将 dequeueBuffer 描述为取得可写缓冲槽，Perfetto 诊断又将该调用等待直接归因于 release fence。Android 17 IGraphicBufferProducer.h:214-236 明确返回槽所有权和 fence，fence signal 前不得覆盖内容；Surface.cpp:752-863 返回 fenceFd，BufferQueueProducer.cpp:347-459 的槽等待与 fence 依赖应分开观察。修复生产阶段、诊断段及对应检查表，保留上游旧 EGL fence 条件分支的边界，不声称所有 dequeue 路径都绝不等待 fence。
findings.summary: dequeueBuffer 成功被等同于 buffer 已可覆写，诊断混淆缓冲槽等待与 release fence 等待

findings.details: android-17.0.0_r1 同时具有 RX/RW 和 RWX 兼容路径。前者将 RO/RX/RELRO 合并为 RX；后者先映射 RWX，仅对段内部完整基础页恢复权限，并只将 RELRO 内部完整页改为只读。跨权限边界的页不能保证完整 RELRO 或 W^X。原 5.3 的无条件保护保证与源码不符；7.3 将 max_android_page_size() 误称为运行时页大小也应同步更正。
findings.summary: 16 KiB 兼容加载被误述为完整恢复原段权限和 RELRO 保护

findings.close_note: 3.3 加入 llvm-readelf 观察命令、共享 LOAD 中 RELRO 末端公式及独占 LOAD 例外；5.2 补充 FixMinAlignFor16KiB 的 RELRO 与段覆盖修正。官方 2026-10-16 指南和 r1 实现相互印证，原函数探针验证有效对齐降低及独占段例外。
findings.details: 官方指南 2026-10-16 版本给出 RELRO 末端对齐检查及独占 LOAD 段例外；r1 CheckProgramHeaderAlignment 调用 FixMinAlignFor16KiB，RELRO 前缀末端不对齐或 LOAD 页覆盖重叠即使 p_align>=16KiB 仍可能降低 min_align 并触发兼容。现文只泛称留意 RELRO，且将 min_align 直接解释为 PT_LOAD 最小 p_align。
findings.summary: ELF 检查缺少 RELRO 边界与有效 min_align 修正条件

findings.close_note: 3.2 补上 AGP<=8.0 的 android.bundle.enableUncompressedNativeLibs=false；6 第四步列出 Pixel 机型及 QPR1/QPR2/Android16 门槛；5.4 保留 attrs_manifest 对仅旧布局应用生效、4KiB/已原生16KiB适配时忽略属性的边界。
findings.details: 官方迁移指南对 AGP<=8.0 除 useLegacyPackaging 外还要求 android.bundle.enableUncompressedNativeLibs=false。设备开关限定 Pixel8/8Pro/8a Android15 QPR1+，Pixel9/9Pro/9ProXL Android15 QPR2+，Pixel9a Android16+；原文使用 Pixel9 系列且未注明 QPR 门槛。
